name: 3-D SPIHT
aliases: Set Partitioning in Hierarchical Trees (SPIHT) application to distance volumes
Zero Tree Coder for Signed-Distance Volumes
definition: An embedded entropy coder for 3-D volumetric data that treats wavelet coefficients as 3-D spatio-temporal orientation trees.
summary: 3-D SPIHT is an embedded entropy coder for volumetric data that exploits 3-D spatio-temporal orientation trees to achieve higher compression ratios than 2-D methods.
